topic: Megawatt Watch APAC: Samsung SDS Gumi 60→120 MW, Perak >100 MW (NDA only), NTT Jakarta 12 MW

sources.title: Samsung SDS begins construction of 60 MW AI data center in Gumi South Korea
facts: Samsung SDS has begun construction of an AI data center in Gongdan-dong, Gumi, North Gyeongsang Province
Initial power capacity of 60 MW, with expansion plans to 120 MW in stages

sources.title: Malaysia's Perak state explores proposed 100MW AI data center
facts: PKNPk and Global Vision Lab are exploring an AI data center in Perak with planned capacity exceeding 100MW
Only a non-disclosure agreement and a letter of consent have been signed

sources.title: NTT Data opens 12MW new Jakarta 2 Annex data center
facts: NTT Data opened the 12MW Jakarta 2 Annex Data Center (JKT2A), Tier III certified, up to 40 kW per rack
Linked to Jakarta 3 in Bekasi, 45 MW IT load capacity
Indonesia: 21 projects, 2646 MW under construction, 1448 MW announced
Malaysia: 26 projects, 1402 MW under construction, 1292 MW announced
South Korea: 9 projects, 542 MW under construction, 350 MW announced

caption:
120 MW: Samsung SDS has started building its Gumi AI campus in South Korea, 60 MW first and 120 MW in stages.

The same day in Asia: a Perak (Malaysia) project of more than 100MW, backed so far only by an NDA and a letter of consent, and NTT Data's 12MW Jakarta 2 Annex, already open.

Three announcements, three very different stages. Our pipeline shows South Korea at 542 MW under construction and 350 MW announced.

Data: Coloprice pipeline tracker, 4 Nov 2026. Sources on the last slide.
